resources.string: Patch a compatible boot.img, init_boot.img, or vendor_boot.img using the matching ZKFC LKM.
Install directly to the active boot slot.
Prepare the next slot after a system update.
Open a compatible AnyKernel package in your root manager.

Select the correct ramdisk image and, when needed, its matching boot.img for kernel identity. KMI detection follows KernelSU-Next: kernel banner first, then an optional vendor module vermagic. File mode writes a patched image only and never flashes partitions.
Select matching boot.img (kernel reference, if needed)

Use images from the same device and firmware build. Following KernelSU-Next's partition policy, android12-* KMI targets boot.img; other KMI branches prefer init_boot.img when that partition exists. When init_boot.img or vendor_boot.img has no kernel payload, select the matching boot.img as the kernel reference. vendor_boot.img is supported only when it contains an init_boot-named or unnamed generic ramdisk fragment.
Select vendor .ko for KMI detection (KernelSU-Next fallback)
Select matching zkfc.ko (optional when this APK bundles the selected KMI)
Choose the KMI for this device
The selected KMI and Linux major/minor family are checked against zkfc.ko. The kernel loader still validates symbol versions when it loads the module.

Use an image from the same device and ROM. AVB is not re-signed: an unlocked bootloader or compatible signing setup is required. Module signature enforcement or KMI mismatch can prevent loading. Keep a known-good recovery image.
Patch completed and verified structurally. Choose where to save the output image.
Direct flashing and inactive-slot installation are not implemented yet. Use file patching or a compatible AnyKernel package.
No KMI branch was found in the kernel banner or optional vendor module. Select manually only if you know the target branch; compatibility remains unverified.
A release APK can use its bundled module for the selected KMI. Choose a file only to override it or when no bundled match is available.
Selected KMI (%1$s) does not match the KMI detected from the image (%2$s). Use the detected branch, or verify that this image is for the intended kernel.
